wages.text: He said he would advocate for higher worker pay and stronger worker rights.
wages.quote: Garcia will advocate for raising workers’ wages, protecting worker rights, protecting retirement security, combating racial and gender discrimination, reducing income inequality, and encouraging workforce diversity.

debt.text: He said he would advocate for protecting retirement security.
debt.quote: Garcia will advocate for raising workers’ wages, protecting worker rights, protecting retirement security, combating racial and gender discrimination, reducing income inequality, and encouraging workforce diversity.

housing.text: In his 2020 Council campaign, Garcia supported more rent control alongside relaxing rules that made it harder for buyers and tenants to get into homes.
housing.quote: Garcia supports and will push for more rent control legislation. He also will support relaxing rules and regulations that make it difficult for buyers and tenants to get into homes.

schools.text: He called for quality public, charter, and private educational institutions rather than taking a position limited to either district schools or school choice.
schools.quote: Quality educational public, charter and private institutions with 21st century infrastructure and educators
